text:
Aisha Patel: Heads up 11 we need a lighter-weight SI co-sell handoff for marketplace-originated leads. Too many duplicates and missed ownership.
Marco Li: Agreed. Seen multiple SIs ping same account. what minimal flow do you want? :eyes:
Samir Khan: My vote: one intake form -> auto-classify -> assign owner -> audit log. Keep it simple so SIs actually use it.
Jules (PM): propose we standardize 3 fields on intake: lead source, mapped-SI? (yes/no), ARR estimate. then rules route it.
Aisha Patel: Draft routing rules below. open to tweaks:
Aisha Patel: ```
1) Source types: Marketplace (MP), Partner Referral (PR), SI Submission (SI)
2) If PR or SI -> route to partner rep listed on referral.
3) If MP -> check CRM mapping: if account has SI_Partner_ID -> route to that SI as owner and CC field rep. else route to field rep by territory.
4) Auto-tag: region, ARR_bucket (<100k, 100k-1M, >1M), product-area (inference/chat/embeddings)
5) SLA: owner must ack within 24h. If no ack -> partner-ops queue; 72h -> partnerships PM escalate.
```
Marco Li: Q: for accounts with multiple SIs, prefer explicit primary flag in mapping table. fallback: last-touch SI.
Samir Khan: +1. also recommend a daily digest to SIs for any MP leads that match mapped accounts so they can triage quickly.
partners-bot: [automated] Daily digest: 6 MP leads matched to mapped accounts today (sent 09:00 UTC).
Jules (PM): Traceability is important. partners-bot should post an audit entry on every handoff and on SLA misses.
Aisha Patel: example bot message: "Handoff created: lead 0xA12 -> SI: CloudForge (owner: Marco Li); tags: US, >100k, embeddings"
Marco Li: tiny ask 1 prefer handoff record to include mapping source (CRM vs manual map) so we can spot stale mappings.
Samir Khan: mapping maintenance is a pain. propose: Partnerships owns quarterly sweeps + auto-verification when a new mapping is added (send verification email to SI contact).
Aisha Patel: also legal will need a short consent snippet for lead-sharing. Samir, can you loop Legal in?
Samir Khan: Already thought about that. I'll ping Legal and attach a template.
Jules (PM): Can we add a short SLA table on expectations for SIs? Helps set response expectations.
Samir Khan: draft: "New opp assignment ack: 24h; joint demo scheduling: 3 business days; LOE estimate: 5 business days"
Marco Li: Works for me. infra side: we can add a simple webhook for intake -> partner CRM mapping lookup. low lift.
Aisha Patel: Next steps: Aisha to open PR with intake form + rules; Marco to push mapping-table schema; Samir to draft legal handoff blurb + SLA snippet. Pilot: 2-week run with CloudForge and Nimbus once merged. Deadline EOW.
partners-bot: [automated] Action created: PR for intake form assigned to Aisha (due Thu).
Aisha Patel: tagging @here 1 any objections or missing pieces? :rocket:
Marco Li: none.
Samir Khan: looping legal now. will report back.
Jules (PM): Great. I'll prepare pilot checklist and onboarding notes for the two SIs.
Aisha Patel: thanks all, moving forward.
